summary: Tested FloForge platform backend and frontend end to end. Backend: 30/37 pytest cases passed; core admin/client auth, cookies, /auth/me, RBAC, revenue, availability, booking buffer, deliverables, leads happy path, messaging, and growth updates work. Seven negative-path tests failed. Frontend required login/register, redirects, admin/client tabs, booking widget, and messaging flows passed.

critical.issue: Server accepts bookings that are not offered availability: Sunday slots, 3:00 AM slots, and misaligned 10:15 AM slots all returned 200 and were persisted. The published Mon-Fri 9 AM-4 PM Arizona 30-minute schedule is only enforced by GET availability, not POST booking.
Naive slot_start and malformed date inputs return 500 Internal Server Error instead of a 4xx validation response.
No brute-force lockout/rate limit: six consecutive invalid admin password attempts all returned 401; the required sixth-attempt lockout did not occur.

Public responses expose Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * together with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, including for an untrusted Origin. This contradicts the configured explicit origin and is an invalid/insecure credentialed CORS policy at the ingress/public layer.

minor.issue: Unsupported status values are accepted and persisted with 200; status is not constrained to new/contacted/converted.

design_issues.screen: Client Book Training and admin quarterly-review forms
issues: Both date fields use the browser-native input type=date picker rather than the app's shadcn calendar component, producing browser-dependent UX.

action_items: Validate POST /api/bookings against the same Arizona weekday/business-hour/30-minute slot rules used by availability; reject any slot not currently offered and preserve the 60-minute separation rule atomically.
Catch malformed availability dates and reject timezone-naive booking timestamps with 400/422; never compare naive and aware datetimes.
Implement per-account/IP login failure tracking and lockout/rate limiting after five failed attempts.
Constrain lead status with a Pydantic Literal/enum and return 4xx for unsupported values.
Correct public ingress CORS so credentialed responses echo only the configured trusted origin and never return wildcard origin.
Retest all seven failed regression cases after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: platform_api.py create_booking only checks future time and distance from existing bookings; it must validate timezone awareness, America/Phoenix schedule, weekday, and minute alignment server-side.

_slots_for_date calls datetime.strptime without handling ValueError, while create_booking compares datetime.fromisoformat output to an aware UTC datetime without checking tzinfo; these are the direct causes of the two 500 paths.
Login performs bcrypt verification directly with no failure counter, throttling, or lockout implementation.
LeadStatusReq.status and DeliverableReq.status are unconstrained strings. Lead status was proven to accept invalid values; use enums/Literals for state fields.
Several admin per-client interactive controls lack data-testid attributes (client expander, review date, growth update input/button, admin message input/send), reducing stable test coverage.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ clients, paid transaction, lead, bookings, messages, and growth updates; platform fixtures cleaned them. The UI test client test_ui_platform_20817@example.com and its records were also cleaned. Existing Stripe regression tests created additional uncompleted test-mode checkout sessions and existing lead tests persisted TEST_ leads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core happy paths are functional. Re-run /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py after fixes; currently expected failures are booking malformed date, naive datetime, Sunday/out-of-hours/misaligned slots, login lockout, and invalid lead status. Public CORS was verified separately with trusted and evil Origin headers and returned wildcard plus credentials for both. Frontend admin/client/protected-route/booking/message flows passed; Google OAuth button presence only was tested, not the external flow.
rca_of_the_issue: Booking schedule rules exist only in the availability generator and are not reused by the booking mutation. Unhandled datetime parsing/timezone assumptions produce ValueError and offset-naive/offset-aware TypeError (confirmed in backend log at platform_api.py line 268). Auth has no failure-tracking state. Lead status uses an unconstrained string model. Public CORS headers appear to be overwritten or broadened by the Cloudflare/ingress layer despite the backend .env containing an explicit origin.
